limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Illustrative failure-plane and sliding-plug model, not individual grain dynamics or calibrated soil strength.
Chosen 500 bridges are not a water-content percentage; complete-wetting contact estimate is used.
Bridges rupture at failure; no reformation, grain rearrangement, drainage, vibration or detailed liquid-bridge solution.
Same friction coefficient before/after failure; perfectly inelastic end stop.
Grains and contact inset are enlarged; motion is replayed 6× slower with model time recorded.
